summary: The native mapping compiles and handles basic Base64 text, but the public nodeutf8.Decode function violates the required raw-byte input contract. Direct Go probes and compiled ABAP tests also reproduce incorrect replacement handling for incomplete UTF-8 and surrogate encodings; the added Go tests pass without covering these failures.

findings.claim: Decode interprets its input as Base64 instead of raw bytes, contrary to the explicitly required public API. Valid raw text is corrupted or discarded: Decode("abc") returns "i�" and Decode("äöü") returns an empty string. Keep Base64 decoding in the ABAP wrapper and make nodeutf8.Decode interpret the resulting bytes as UTF-8.
findings.repro: Call nodeutf8.Decode("abc") and nodeutf8.Decode("äöü"): expected "abc" and "äöü", actual "i�" and "". Reproduced with: cd /work/tools/gogen/go && go run /tmp/review-b64.go

findings.claim: Consuming only one byte after every failed sequence emits one replacement per byte of a valid but incomplete UTF-8 prefix. Node consumes that prefix as one malformed sequence. Consequently DecodeBase64("4oI=") returns two replacements instead of one, and DecodeBase64("4oJB") returns "��A" instead of "�A", also producing the wrong ABAP strlen.
findings.repro: ABAP: DATA val TYPE string. val = cl_http_utility=>decode_base64( '4oJB' ). cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = strlen( val ) exp = 2 ). Fails with actual 3. Node: Buffer.from("4oJB", "base64").toString() yields "�A". Also reproduced by cd /work/tools/gogen/go && go run /tmp/review-b64.go.

findings.claim: The three-byte validator accepts UTF-8 encodings of surrogate code points (ED A0 80 through ED BF BF). Those are invalid UTF-8 and Node replaces each byte, but this code copies them unchanged into the result. DecodeBase64("7aCA") therefore returns invalid bytes ED A0 80; the ABAP runtime treats them as one surrogate unit and strlen returns 1 instead of the required 3 replacements.
findings.repro: ABAP: DATA val TYPE string. val = cl_http_utility=>decode_base64( '7aCA' ). cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = strlen( val ) exp = 3 ). Fails with actual 1. Node: Buffer.from("7aCA", "base64").toString() yields "���". Go utf8.ValidString(abap.DecodeBase64(&abap.Session{}, "7aCA")) returns false.
